purpose: Opt-in PR02 experiment. No tested adaptive setting clears the combined latency/quality guard; legacy remains default.

measurement_vs_final_pcm_equivalence.scope: PCM segment counts, order and exact float samples; not wall-clock latency or speech accuracy

measurement_harness_limitations: Main matrix ran before runner watchdog/fallback/cleanup corrections and the forced-cap quiet-duration correction. All VAD sessions processed positive segments with the requested mode and no fallback warning appeared. Final audio produced byte-identical float PCM segment arrays on all 76 input/config cases. This is not a remeasurement of all final-code timing or recognition.

quality_definitions.scope: One independently referenced Japanese sentence and, optionally, one English sentence. This does not establish broad accuracy or a release gate.
quality_definitions.japanese: NFKC, casefold, remove punctuation and whitespace, character Levenshtein distance.
quality_definitions.english: NFKC, casefold, Unicode letter/number word tokens (hyphens separate words), word Levenshtein distance.
quality_definitions.aggregation: Concatenate all ASR text for each sample/round without deduplication; sum edits and reference lengths across rounds. A present session with no output counts as deletion of the entire reference.
quality_definitions.privacy: Only counts and reference hashes are exported; local dialogue sidecars are not copied.

final_runner_supplemental.scope: Separate controlled browser run on final source: one frozen Japanese positive, six previously meaning-reviewed dialogue crops, seven previously user-listened no-speech music/action crops, and two-second silence. Two rounds. These selected crops do not replace the frozen latency corpus or establish broad quality.
final_runner_supplemental.preparation: Original public-source crop bytes verified against recorded hashes, then 512 ms leading / 1024 ms trailing silence added. No audio redistributed. Labels come from the prior user listening record; no new listening review performed here.
